subtitle: Maritime risks, documented incidents and EU coastal security
statementExplainer: Verified official records first. Press reports and automated discoveries are labelled separately.
chartNote: Documented incidents only. Mine-response operations excluded; incomplete reporting is not evidence of no incidents.
independent: Independent research project, not an EU institution
notVerified: Automatically indexed; not a verified official statement.
notLocated: No reliable location available; this entry is archive-only.
locationApprox: Map marker is approximate, not a verified strike coordinate.
sourceNotice: Claims and incident attribution are reported with their sources. A claim is not a confirmed finding.
aboutIntro: An independent public-interest research site documenting maritime-security risks relevant to the EU Black Sea coast of Romania and Bulgaria. Not affiliated with the EU, NATO or any government.
aboutEditorText: Independent research project. A named editor and accountable operator have not yet been provided; do not imply an institutional affiliation.
aboutScopeText: Incidents include reported attacks on vessels, naval mines, drone debris and attacks affecting ports or coastal facilities in the Romanian/Bulgarian maritime-security context. Mine-countermeasure operations are listed separately as responses, not attacks.
aboutEvidenceText: First-party public releases and reliable reporting are linked. Official = first-party institutional source. Press = media reporting. Auto = discovered lead awaiting checks. Actor attribution is claimed, authority-confirmed, or undetermined; each incident has separate attribution details. Multiple outlets can repeat the same claim.
aboutLocationText: Map positions may be approximate administrative, offshore or symbolic areas. They must never be treated as verified strike coordinates or navigation information. Unlocated automatic candidates are not placed on the map.
aboutUpdatesText: Discovery automation proposes changes by pull request; publication requires review and merge. Data is not complete or real-time. To request a correction, supply the record URL, a primary source and an explanation. Configure a real contact email before going live.
